state: Before

panel 368 wide · padding 16 · rows 32 · meta 11.5 dim
only kit tokens; no colour but the marks

Subtract information, never options. At rest a panel drops facts that repeat or say nothing now: scope lines, second lines, labels, marks and colour with no reason. Those facts come back under the pointer or keyboard. Every action and option, those the app has and those we added, stays visible and one press away. Colour stays only on what asks for you, and failures stay loud.
